description: This plot illustrates the WER during fine-tuning of the Whisper model for the "tiny" type. The x-axis is labeled "epoch" and uses a linear scale ranging from 0 to 6, with tick marks at intervals of 1. The y-axis is labeled "WER" and uses a linear scale ranging from 20 to 70, with tick marks at intervals of 10. The plot contains five lines representing different configurations. The "tiny AdaLoRA_int4" configuration is shown as a grey solid line with circle markers, starting at approximately 69 at epoch 0 and decreasing to roughly 36 at epoch 6. The "tiny AdaLoRA_int8" configuration is depicted by a grey solid line with square markers, beginning at about 60 at epoch 0 and declining to approximately 32 at epoch 6. The "tiny int4" configuration is represented by a grey dashed line with circle markers, starting at roughly 69 at epoch 0 and decreasing to about 40 at epoch 6. The "tiny int8" configuration is shown as a grey dashed line with square markers, beginning at approximately 60 at epoch 0 and declining to roughly 37 at epoch 6. Finally, the "tiny full" configuration is depicted by a grey dotted line with upward-pointing triangle markers, starting at about 29 at epoch 0 and decreasing slightly to approximately 23 at epoch 6.
